item.necromancy.creature_part.head: %s Head
trait.necromancy.gills.desc: With gills on its head or torso, the Minion never runs out of air.
trait.necromancy.cactus_proof.desc: Cacti and berry bushes cannot hurt it.
trait.necromancy.reaper.desc: Its killing blows bottle the soul for you, as a scythe would (with a glass bottle, within 16 blocks).
trait.necromancy.floats.desc: Bobs on the surface of the water.
trait.necromancy.on_hit_ignite.desc: Hits set the target alight for %s s.
trait.necromancy.on_hit_ignite.desc.chan: %s of hits set the target alight for %s s.
trait.necromancy.on_hit_toss.desc.chance: %s of hits hurl the target away.
trait.necromancy.on_hit_disarm.desc: %s of hits knock a held or worn item off a mob.
trait.necromancy.on_hit_block.desc: %s of hits wrap the target in cobweb for %s s (needs mobGriefing).
trait.necromancy.lifesteal.desc: Heals %s of the damage it deals, up to %s a hit.
trait.necromancy.charge.desc: After a %s-block run, the next hit deals ×%s damage and knocks back.
trait.necromancy.charge.desc.ambush: Its first hit after %2$s s out of the fight deals ×%1$s damage.
trait.necromancy.pack.desc: +%s damage for each nearby Minion with the same part, up to +%s.
trait.necromancy.ranged.desc: Every %s s, at targets up to %s blocks away.
trait.necromancy.leap.desc: Leaps at targets %s to %s blocks away and lands softly.
trait.necromancy.teleport.to_target.desc: Teleports next to targets more than %s blocks away, every %s s.
trait.necromancy.teleport.away_when_hurt: %s chance to teleport away from projectiles and magic.
trait.necromancy.teleport.victim.desc: %s of hits teleport the target up to %s blocks away.
trait.necromancy.on_hurt_reflect.desc.fr: Melee attackers take %s of the damage back, up to %s.
trait.necromancy.on_hurt_reflect.desc.fi: Sets melee attackers alight for %s s.
trait.necromancy.on_hurt_knockback.desc: %s chance to bounce melee attackers away.
trait.necromancy.last_stand.desc: Once every %2$s s, a blow that leaves it below %1$s health makes it rally.
trait.necromancy.on_death_explode.desc.f: Bursts into flame when it falls (power %s).
trait.necromancy.on_death_cloud.desc: Leaves a cloud of %s, %s blocks wide, when it falls.
trait.necromancy.summon.desc: Calls up to %s spawnlings while fighting; they crumble after %s s.
trait.necromancy.summon.desc.hurt: Calls up to %s spawnlings when hurt; they crumble after %s s.
trait.necromancy.aura.desc.enemies: Every %2$s s, to enemies within %1$s blocks.
trait.necromancy.aura.desc.allies: Every %2$s s, to allies within %1$s blocks.
trait.necromancy.aura.desc.owner: Every %2$s s, to you, within %1$s blocks.
trait.necromancy.pull.desc: Drags smaller targets within %s blocks towards it.
trait.necromancy.interact_yield.desc: Use %s on it, once every %s s.
trait.necromancy.forager.desc: Under the Work order, breaks %s within %s blocks of its post and packs the drops.
trait.necromancy.forager.desc.eat: When hurt and idle, eats %s to heal %s.
trait.necromancy.mount.desc.direct: Saddle it and steer with the movement keys.
trait.necromancy.mount.desc.stick: Saddle it and steer with a Brain on a Stick.
trait.necromancy.glide.desc: Falls slowly and takes no fall damage.
trait.necromancy.glide.desc.pair: With both wings, falls slowly and takes no fall damage.
trait.necromancy.emits_light.desc: Lights up the dark around it (level %s).
trait.necromancy.transfuse.desc: Gives you its own health while you are below %s health.
